description: This file contains helper functions and setup routines for testing bitmap functionality within Git repositories. It includes functions for comparing traversal outputs, setting up complex commit histories, creating and verifying pack and multi-pack index files, and running various bitmap-related tests.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares traversal outputs between bitmap and non-bitmap listings, ensuring they're equivalent after normalization.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a complex commit history with various merges and commits to test bitmap handling with diverse repository states.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs several rev-list commands with and without bitmaps, comparing their outputs to ensure bitmap correctness.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs the head-specific rev-list tests across multiple branches.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Performs essential bitmap tests including verification, clone, partial clone, and bitmap enumeration with various scenarios.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks whether a Git object has a specific base delta object, verifying delta relationships.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines the pack file source of a given object by inspecting the multi-pack index.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a reverse index for a specific commit in the repository.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Creates a multi-pack index with bitmaps, runs core bitmap tests, and performs various setup and verification operations including pack creation, delta verification, and cloning tests.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Sets up and tests partial bitmap scenarios, verifying handling of partial pack bitmaps and complex histories.
